description.value: An Australian Medicare Provider Number is assigned by Services Australia under the Medicare program to practitioners who provide services that are eligible for a Medicare benefit. A practitioner may have more than one Medicare provider number if they deliver health services in different locations or are registered in multiple health professions. Changes to this naming system are managed by the Australian HL7 Affiliate (HL7 Australia).
